sql: BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT a.name,a.git_repository,a.git_branch,s.is_auto_deploy_enabled,s.is_preview_deployments_enabled FROM applications a LEFT JOIN application_settings s ON s.application_id=a.id WHERE a.git_repository ILIKE '%SrEdgarR/MECANET.git' OR a.git_repository ILIKE '%SrEdgarR/MECANET'; ROLLBACK;
